$comment: Gzip bytes. Budgets sit 2% above the sizes at the time they were set; lower them as bundles shrink (bun scripts/perf/bundle.ts --update). A budget that rises needs a "why" on its entry, such as { "gzip": 290000, "why": "..." }; bun run perf:guards checks it. Targets are Plan 15 goals and are not enforced yet.

entry.why: Personal sidebar organization: Pinned Spaces, the person's groups with their menus and focus, the Worktable header menu, and saving the arrangement in the background.

root css.why: The theme defines eight recognition colors, each with solid, ink and soft values in light and dark. Docs share one reading stylesheet (document-content.css), which the saved preview needs before the app's JavaScript loads so nothing moves when a Doc opens. It replaces markdown.css and the preview overrides, and adds lists, checklists, code headers, tables, toggles, diagrams and the text color palette; controls that only appear once a Doc is interactive load with the viewer and editor instead.

home.why: Personal sidebar organization: Pinned Spaces, the person's groups with their menus and focus, the Worktable header menu, and saving the arrangement in the background.

space.why: Personal sidebar organization: Pinned Spaces, the person's groups with their menus and focus, the Worktable header menu, and saving the arrangement in the background.

rich document.why: The sidebar footer shows who is signed in, with a menu for Profile, Preferences, the theme and Sign Out, and Settings groups into You, the Worktable and Support.

html document.why: Worktable Teams: HTML documents open read-only for members with read access, and address their frame by the member's per-Space content key (Plan 16). The personal sidebar organization adds Pinned Spaces, groups and the Worktable header menu.
